financings_after_balance_sheet.what: October 2025 ATM sales under Leerink Sales Agreement (exact day not given; month-end used)
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: In October 2025, 1,175,000 shares of the Company's common stock were sold pursuant to the Leerink Sales Agreement for net proceeds to the Company of $9.5 million, after deducting issuance costs.

financings_after_balance_sheet.what: 2025 underwritten public offering of common stock and pre-funded warrants, closed Nov 7, 2025
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: The net proceeds from the Offering were approximately $93.3 million, after deducting the underwriting discounts and commissions and other estimated offering expenses payable by the Company. The Offering closed on November 7, 2025.

warrants.quote: This number does not include 10,513,949 shares of common stock issuable upon the exercise of pre-funded warrants outstanding as of November 7, 2025
In December 2020, the Company issued a warrant for 30,000 shares of the Company’s common stock to a service provider with an exercise price of $18.00 per share.
